doc: Reviewed ceiling on duplicate-excess AST nodes; the gate refuses commits above it. Lower with clone-census -update-baseline after tightening. Raised 10206 to 10431 because 152 exact fallback, ticker, clone, and typed-sort rewrites normalized formerly distinct control flow into shared standard-library forms while the complete manual sweep lowered measured modern-Go candidates from 743 to 581; no production surface was added.
